exposure: exclusive breastfeeding within 72 hours after delivery
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding rate at 6 months postpartum
cohort: 562 in-hospital mothers within 72 hours postpartum at a regional teaching hospital in Guangzhou, China
finding: Mothers with higher breastfeeding self-efficacy scores, who underwent cesarean section, and practiced exclusive breastfeeding within 72 hours after delivery were significantly associated with a lower hazard of discontinuation of exclusive breastfeeding before 6 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Mothers who underwent cesarean section were significantly associated with a lower hazard of discontinuation of exclusive breastfeeding before 6 months postpartum.
